answer: Each identity registers a reef plot in the reef registry and posts an 80-credit timber bond. Each epoch it files a sonnet declaration naming its plot and timber tally; auditors recheck a sample, and a duplicate claim or mismatch burns the bond and voids the plot. Fees rise one step per filing, so the k-th fake costs 110 plus 10(k-1) credits and 1,000 fakes cost 5,105,000 credits, no discount, no reuse. A rented-plot ring fails: a rented plot carries its owner's key, so the declaration signature never matches. An honest identity posts 110 credits once and recovers its bond after a clean epoch.
